measurement.depth_scale: development median top-5 side depth (native) / 1000; applied unchanged to every period and to BTC
measurement.family_error: v0.4 zi_calibration convention: max over components of dimensionless quantile/moment errors (relative to observed median/level with floors; absolute for bounded quantities); capped at 10
measurement.E3: mean family error over evaluable families

simulator.tick_geometry: relative tick of the development instrument

families.self_exciting_inclusion: development trade-count dispersion index (var/mean of 1 s counts) > 1.5
families.combined: union of extensions whose selection loss is below the control's selection loss; fitted on development with the same budget, starting from the control optimum and each member's fitted parameters
families.simple_control: iid_joint: IID resampling of development 1 s observations (spread, depth, imbalance, returns); not a simulator, not selectable, evaluated only on families it can express

search.batches: 24 global/perturbed + 24 refinement around the batch-1 optimum

selection: minimum selection-period E3 among control, admitted candidates and combined; ties by fewer parameters; sealed in the ledger before any holdout access

inference.H3a: paired chronological block bootstrap of (selected E3 - control E3) over 600 s historical blocks, simulated summaries fixed; 2000 resamples; two-sided alpha 0.05/3 per holdout; improvement ESTABLISHED iff upper bound < 0
inference.H3b: per holdout: every evaluable family error <= 0.60, valid fraction >= 0.95, >= 1000 valid 1 s samples

reporting: retrospective label on the June internal holdout
BTC evaluated with the ETH development scale and tick geometry: a transfer test, not a re-calibration
